stem: Ojas studies this paddy-field food chain: paddy plants → rat → snake → eagle.

parts.text: Which statement correctly assigns the trophic levels?

options.text: Paddy plants are first (producers); the rat is second; the snake is third; the eagle is later.
The eagle is first because it is the largest animal in the chain.
The rat is first even though it does not make its own food from sunlight.
Every animal in the chain is at the first trophic level.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Producers come first; the herbivore rat is second; the snake is a small carnivore at the third level; the eagle is a larger carnivore later.

teacher.key_rationale: Producers are first, herbivores second, small carnivores third, larger carnivores later. Ranking by size is a surface feature; putting the rat first omits the producer rule; placing every animal first over-widens the first level.
